editorial.blurb: La Parrilla is a chic Colombian steakhouse that marries sophisticated ambiance with warm, welcoming service and authentically flavorful cuisine.
editorial.insiderTip: Request a table toward the back for a more private feel, and ask your server for drink recommendations—the passion fruit margarita is legendary among regulars.

topDishes.note: Perfectly cooked, packed with flavor—a standout Colombian classic
Well-cooked meat makes the soup exceptionally flavorful
Flavorful and not greasy, made with care
